title: Self-Supervised In-Context Operator Learning for Optimal Mixing in Incompressible Flows
summary: We develop a self-supervised operator-learning framework for optimal mixing in incompressible flows, aimed at overcoming the computational limitations of classical PDE-constrained optimal control. The objective is to design velocity fields that efficiently homogenize a passive scalar while minimizing kinetic energy, quantified through the $\dot H^{-1}(Ω)$ mix-norm. Classical methods solve a separate optimal control problem for each initial condition using iterative forward-adjoint procedures, leading to substantial computational costs and limited scalability.
